title: A Straight Line
description_md:
Welcome to **Roboverse X**. Your first task is to move forward.

Use the arrow keys (`W` or `↑`) to draw the line shown on the grid. Stay within the red boundary to pass.

title: Script a Square
description_md:
Write a Python ROS 2 program to draw a 2×2 unit square.

Publish `Twist` messages to `/turtle1/cmd_vel`. You have a 120 second time limit. The program ends when the turtle stops moving for 5 seconds.
starter_code:
import rclpy, time, math
from rclpy.node import Node
from geometry_msgs.msg import Twist

def main():
    rclpy.init()
    node = Node("square")
    pub = node.create_publisher(Twist, "/turtle1/cmd_vel", 10)
    
    # HINT: Publish forward, wait, publish turn, wait... 4 times.
    
    # ...
    
    node.destroy_node()
    rclpy.shutdown()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
